engine: SAHJONY Cuba Customs Release Provider Scanner
market: Cuba customs clearance, port release, airport cargo release and final-mile handoff

legalFramework.currentReference: Cuba Decreto-Ley 108 de Aduanas and Decreto 134, effective framework published 2026
rules: A customs agency must be authorized by the head of the Aduana General de la Republica.
A freight forwarder/transitario may act as a customs agency only when separately authorized by the Aduana General de la Republica.
Ship agents and accredited aircraft representatives participate in customs formalities for vessels and aircraft.
Registration before Aduana is required for customs agencies, freight forwarders, regular shipping lines, port/airport operators and other covered actors.
legalFramework.approvalGate: No provider may be marked APPROVED_AUTHORIZED_FIRST_HAND without current authorization/role evidence applicable to the requested cargo and entry point.

regulatorySources.name: Aduana General de la Republica de Cuba
